points.description: States that the independence assumption does not hold for real internet traffic, because arrivals are bursty and depend on earlier arrivals (e.g. a stream's playback state or segment loading makes the next arrival depend on previous ones). Equivalent wording, or any correct example of dependence between arrivals, earns the mark. A bare 'No' with no reason earns nothing.

rubric.notes: A single mark, so this is all-or-nothing. Full marks for a clear 'no' plus a reason that arrivals are dependent or bursty. The video-streaming example is illustrative and is not required. A 'no' with no justification gets no credit.
